pp2.5:1.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo ārabhati ca vippaṭisārī ca hoti tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatth' assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti, so evaṃ assa vacanīyo:--
pp2.5:1.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā pavaḍḍhanti,
pp2.5:1.3: sādhu vatāyasmā ārambhaje āsave pahāya vippaṭisāraje āsave paṭivinodetvā cittaṃ paññañ ca bhāvetu,
pp2.5:1.4: evam āyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatī ti.
pp2.5:2.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo ārabhati na vippaṭisārī hoti tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatth' assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti so evam assa vacanīyo:--
pp2.5:2.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā nappavaḍḍhanti,
pp2.5:2.3: sādhu vatāyasmā ārambhaje āsave pahāya cittaṃ paññañ ca bhāvetu,
pp2.5:2.4: evam āyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatī ti.
pp2.5:3.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo na ārabhati vippaṭisārī hoti tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatth' assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti, so sevaṃ assa vacanīyo:--
pp2.5:3.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā na saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā pavaḍḍhanti,
pp2.5:3.3: sādhu vatāyasmā vippatisāraje āsave paṭivinodetvā cittaṃ paññañ ca bhāvetu,
pp2.5:3.4: evam āyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatī ti.
pp2.5:4.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ puggalo na ārabhati na vippaṭisārī hoti tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatth' assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti, so evam assa vacanīyo:--
pp2.5:4.2: āyasmato kho ārambhajā āsavā na saṃvijjanti vippaṭisārajā āsavā nappavaḍḍhanti,
pp2.5:4.3: sādhu vatāyasmā cittaṃ paññañ ca bhāvetu,
pp2.5:4.4: evam āyasmā amunā pañcamena puggalena samasamo bhavissatī ti.
pp2.5:5.1: Ime cattāro puggalā amunā pañcamena puggalena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evam anusāsiyamānā anupubbena āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇanti. 2.
pp2.5:6.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo yassa puggalassa deti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tassa evaṃ hoti:--
pp2.5:6.3: ayaṃ dammi, avaṃ pana paṭigaṇhātī ti, tam enaṃ datvā avajānāti,
pp2.5:7.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasati dve vā tīṇi vā vassāni tam enaṃ saṃvāsena avajānāti,
pp2.5:8.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne khippañ ñeva adhimuccitā hoti,
pp2.5:9.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhatti ittarapemo ittarappasādo,
pp2.5:10.1: Kathañ ca puggalo mando momūho hoti?
pp2.5:10.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kusalākusale dhamme na jānāti sāvajjānavajje dhamme na jānāti hīnappaṇīte dhamme na jānāti kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme na jānāti,
pp2.5:11.3: Idh' ekacco yodhājīvo rajāggañ ñeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdāti na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
pp2.5:11.4: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti
pp2.5:11.5: ayaṃ paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ. Idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ, api ca kho dhajaggañ ñeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
pp2.5:12.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti
pp2.5:12.3: ayaṃ dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ
pp2.5:13.1: Puna ca paraṃ. Idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
pp2.5:13.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti
pp2.5:13.3: ayaṃ tatiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ. Idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ api ca kho saṃpahāre haññati vyāpajjati,
pp2.5:14.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti
pp2.5:14.3: ayaṃ catuttho yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:15.1: Puna ca paraṃ. Idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ
pp2.5:15.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo, tam eva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati,
pp2.5:15.3: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti
pp2.5:15.4: ayaṃ pañcamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:15.5: Ime pañca yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
pp2.5:16.1: evam evaṃ pañc' ime yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:17.1: Idh' ekacco bhikkhu rajaggañ ñeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāya āvattati.
pp2.5:17.4: asukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā ti,
pp2.5:17.5: so taṃ sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ, sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāya āvattati,
pp2.5:18.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo rajaggañ ñeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.5:18.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco puggalo hoti
pp2.5:18.3: ayaṃ paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
pp2.5:19.1: Puna ca param. Idh' ekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ api ca kho dhajaggañ ñeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hināya āvattati.
pp2.5:19.3: Idha bhikkhu na h' eva kho suṇāti
pp2.5:19.4: asukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā ti, api ca kho sāmañ ca passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ,
pp2.5:19.5: so taṃ disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāya āvattati
pp2.5:20.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ api ca kho dhajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.5:20.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco puggalo hoti
pp2.5:20.3: ayaṃ dutiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:21.1: Puna ca param. Idh' ekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāya āvattati.
pp2.5:21.3: Idha bhikkhuṃ āraññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati ullapati ujjaggheti uppaṇḍeti,
pp2.5:21.4: so mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjagghiyamāno uppaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ sikkhā dubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāya āvattati,
pp2.5:22.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.5:22.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco puggalo hoti
pp2.5:22.3: ayaṃ tatiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:23.1: Puna ca paraṃ. Idh' ekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ api ca kho saṃpahāre haññati vyāpajjati.
pp2.5:23.3: Idha bhikkhuṃ āraññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati,
pp2.5:23.4: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati,
pp2.5:24.1: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ apo ca kho sampahāre haññati vyāpajjati, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.5:24.2: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco puggalo hoti
pp2.5:24.3: ayaṃ catuttho yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:25.1: Puna ca param. Idh' ekacco bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ,
pp2.5:25.2: so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tam eva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
pp2.5:25.4: Idha bhikkhuṃ āraññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati,
pp2.5:25.5: so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno viniveṭhetvā vinimocetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati,
pp2.5:26.1: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati āraññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriṃ guhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ:
pp2.5:26.2: so āraññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā:
pp2.5:26.3: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.5:26.4: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.5:26.5: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati, ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.5:26.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.5:26.7: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati, akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.5:27.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
pp2.5:28.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti:
pp2.5:28.2: so idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
pp2.5:28.3: ime āsavā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
pp2.5:29.1: Tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati,
pp2.5:29.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karanīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāti.
pp2.5:29.5: seyyathāpi so yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ, so taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhinivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo taṃ eva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo,
pp2.5:29.6: evarūpo pi idh' ekacco puggalo hoti
pp2.5:29.7: ayaṃ pañcamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
pp2.5:30.1: Ime pañca yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu. 4.
pp2.5:31.2: Mandattā momūhattā piṇḍapātiko hoti, pāpiccho icchāpakato piṇḍapātiko hoti, ummādā cittavikkhepo piṇḍapātiko hoti, vaṇṇitaṃ buddhehi buddhasāvakehī ti piṇḍapātiko hoti, api ca appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idamaṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissāya piṇḍapātiko hoti.
pp2.5:31.3: Tatra yvāyaṃ piṇḍapātiko appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idamaṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissāya piṇḍapātiko, ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ piṇḍapātikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca:
pp2.5:32.1: seyyathāpi nāma gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tattha aggam akkhāyati,
pp2.5:32.2: evam evaṃ svāyaṃ piṇḍapātiko appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idamaṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissāya piṇḍapātiko: ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ piṇḍapātikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca;
pp2.5:34.2: Mandattā momūhattā sosāniko hoti, pāpiccho icchāpakato sosāniko hoti, ummādā cittavikkhepo sosāniko hoti, vaṇṇitaṃ buddhehi buddhasāvakehi ti sosāniko hoti, api ca appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idam aṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissāya sosāniko hoti.
pp2.5:34.3: Tatra yvāyaṃ sosāniko appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idamaṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissāya sosāniko, ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sosānikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca:
pp2.5:35.1: seyyathāpi nāma gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tattha aggam akkhāyati,
pp2.5:35.2: evam evaṃ svāyaṃ sosāniko appicchaṃ yeva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ yeva nissāya sallekhaṃ yeva nissāya idamaṭṭhikaṃ yeva nissaya sosāniko hoti: ayaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sosānikānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca pavaro ca;
